turns.content: Identify a reagent that converts adamantane-1-carboxylic acid directly to the corresponding acyl azide.
Name the governing activation method and explain why it is compatible with a carboxylic-acid starting material.
State the intermediate formed when the acyl azide is heated before hydrolysis.
Identify the workup conditions that convert this intermediate to the primary amine.
Give the two missing reagent sets in reaction order.
Trace the carboxyl carbon through acyl azide, isocyanate, and hydrolysis/decarboxylation, and explain why sodium azide alone is not the stated direct activation of the acid.
Report the reagent sequence and name the rearrangement.
